description: This file contains the implementation of the CBC cipher method for AWS cryptography, specifically a class named Cbc with methods to manage encryption IVs, get cipher names, and update state based on ciphertext blocks.

classes.name: Cbc
classes.description: Implementation of CBC cipher method for AWS cryptography, supporting AES encryption with IV management, but marked as deprecated.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IV and keySize, validates IV length.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name based on key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the string describing the AES cipher in CBC mode with PKCS5Padding.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates whether the cipher requires padding, always true for CBC in this implementation.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets IV to the base IV or throws an exception for unsupported seeks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the IV based on the last ciphertext block.
